description:
PearList keeps your household's shared lists in sync across everyone's phones, with no account, no server and no company in the middle.

Make a grocery list, a to-do list or a chore board. Anyone in your household can add items, check them off, rename them, assign them and delete them, and every change syncs directly between your phones. Assign an item to a person and any list doubles as a shared chore board.

There is no sign-up and no login. You join a household by scanning a QR code or tapping an invite link. From then on everyone sees and edits the same lists.
  
Because PearList is peer-to-peer, your lists live only on your devices. They are never uploaded to a server, so no company can read them, sell them or lose them in a breach. Everything syncs encrypted, directly device to device.

Features
 - Multiple shared lists per household: groceries, to-dos, chores
 - Add, check, rename, assign and delete items, synced to everyone
 - Assign items to a person to use any list as a chore board
 - Join by QR code or invite link, no account needed
 - Works offline, syncs when your devices are online together
 - Open source and private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking

PearList is fully open source: https://github.com/peerloomllc/pearlist
promotionalText: Shared household lists that sync directly between your phones. No account, no server, no tracking. Groceries, to-dos and chores, private by design.
whatsNew:
New Features
  - Your Lists page now shows your lists and notes as cards in two columns. You can switch back to rows with the switch above them.
  - Give any list or note a color and pin it to the top. Everyone in the space sees the same colors and pins.
  - Add labels to lists and notes, then tap a label at the top of the Lists page to show only what has it.
  - Notes can now hold up to 10 photos. Note cards show the photo, or small thumbnails when there are several.
  - Share into PearList from other apps. Send a web page, some text or photos from the share menu, then choose to make a new note, add to the end of a note or add it to a list. Works on Android and iPhone.
  - Links in notes are now tappable and open in your browser. List items with a link in their name or note get a link button too.
  - New "Match phone" setting under Appearance, so PearList switches between light and dark along with your phone.

Improvements
  - Ticked items now move to the bottom of the list. You can turn this off in Settings under Lists & aisles.
  - The "All done" pop-up can now be turned off, either in Settings or with "Don't show this again" on the pop-up.

Bug Fixes
  - The status bar at the top of the screen is readable again in light mode.
  - On iPhone, the keyboard now matches PearList's theme.

Privacy
  - The Android app no longer includes Google's Firebase or Google Play's install tracking, and it no longer asks for permissions it never used (drawing over other apps, storage and microphone).
